note: City of Biwabik campground on Embarrass Lake, a mile east of town off MN-135, beside the city's beach, boat launch, docks and fishing pier, with direct access to the Mesabi Trail and an ATV/OHV trail. Sites are sold by the night, month or season; tent and group sites as well. --Claude

No rate posted anywhere official (no fee written); stored website (Explore MN) refused. Not waterfront kept; pin confirmed; note rewritten.

SITES count 59 (derived from an Explore MN note) left: CampLife sells 30 sites online (RV 3, 12, 15, 25, 28, 31, 38, 41A, 41B, 45, 46, 49-53, 55, 68; tent 5, 7, 27, 56, 59, 60; group tent 61-62; group 63-66) and the regional tourism listing (ironrange.org) says '48 campsites available (Camper/RV, tent, group, and lakeside sites)'. The gap is probably seasonal or monthly sites ('this campground has campsites at daily, monthly, or seasonal rates'); a real public city campground with most listed sites sold online by the night, not a seasonal-lease park. Sewer (derived 'some full hookup') left; ironrange.org says 'RV sites with full hookups (water, electric, and sewer)'. Electric 50 is the CampLife RV site type's amenity list (type-level, not per site).
SEASON 05-01..09-30 (derived) left: no operator season found.
OHV: CampLife says 'Direct access to ATV/OHV trail and the Mesabi bike and walk trails'; a general city campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp. Flag only.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept. On MnGeo fsa2025 (fall 2025) the camping loops sit in woods west of the city's day-use area; the nearest campers on an open lawn at about 47.5299,-92.3244 are ~80 m from the shore with the boat-launch parking lot, beach paths and docks between, and one camper in the trees at about 47.5292,-92.3239 is ~50 m back through trees. Ironrange.org mentions 'Premium lakeside sites' (site numbers unknown); a lakeview is possible for the lawn sites across the lot but no site photo confirms an overlook.
PIN 47.53031,-92.32643 sits in the west camping loop; confirmed. CampLife's own point 47.535436,-92.318525 is a lakeside house by MN-135 ~800 m NE; ignore it.
